'''Edan II''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Edan system/Legends|Edan system]]. Although [[Edan Base]] was taken out by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] regained the planet, defeating the Imperial [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] natives [[Teles Jalahafi]] and [[Shela Jalahafi]].
